title: Emergency Shelters
agency: Fairfax County Office to Prevent and End Homelessness
content: Fairfax County families with children seeking emergency shelter can contact Coordinated Services Planning at 703-222-0880 (TTY 711), Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. A specialist will assess needs and determine shelter eligibility. After hours, families can go to the nearest family shelter: Katherine K. Hanley Family Shelter (Fairfax) 571-522-6800; Fair Ridge Shelter (Fairfax) 703-536-2155; Next Steps Family Program (Alexandria) 703-360-1727. Adults without children can call Bailey's Shelter and Supportive Housing (703-820-7621), Eleanor U. Kennedy Shelter (703-799-0200), or Embry Rucker Community Shelter (703-437-1975). Overflow capacity operates during extreme weather; register for alerts by texting FFXOPEH to 888-777. Domestic violence survivors can call the 24-hour hotline at 703-360-7273.
